description: Apply one bulk action to many calendar events at once, including shifts, explicit reschedules, queue moves, cancellations, or assignments.

applyScope.description: Whether to affect only the selected IDs or their recurrence groups.

ids.description: Calendar event IDs or scheduled post IDs to update.

scheduledAt.description: Replacement ISO 8601 time for the 'set_time' action.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for queue-based moves.

name: bulk_update_calendar_events
title: Bulk Update Calendar Events
